sentences.en: Sami is a medium. He can communicate with the dead.
sentences.zh: 萨米是一名灵媒。他能与死者沟通。

sentences.en: Television is a very important medium through which to provide information.
sentences.zh: 电视是一个非常重要的传播信息的媒介。

sentences.en: Television is a very important medium for giving information.
sentences.zh: 电视是一个非常重要的提供信息的渠道。
